method: Deterministic geometric stroked-path authoring; no image generation, tracing, scaling, or copying decoded game bitmap masks.
adaptation: S,O,R,M geometric paths follow established authored fixed-label vocabulary; T follows existing FRONT label; M widened to its original five-unit slot. All coverage is recomputed analytically from segment distance at 32 samples per logical axis.
original_reference_use: Read-only visual comparison and dimension/palette-role audit. No decoded source arrays or palette RGB arrays are in this package.
scope: Only STORM heading, local25x5. Original lower8rows and ammo retained by integrator.
distribution_scope: Only this public-artwork directory is eligible for later review/publication. Sibling private previews, source comparisons, and raw runtime data are excluded.
